name: setgroups32
synopsis: int setgroups(size_t size, const gid_t *_Nullable list);
description: Sets the supplementary group IDs for the calling process. Appropriate privileges are required, and the size argument specifies the number of IDs in the buffer pointed to by list.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of supplementary group IDs in the buffer pointed to by list.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Array of new supplementary group IDs.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The calling process has insufficient privilege.
